description: Production readiness scrub - bugs, security issues, dead code, and robustness improvements identified during code review.

userStories.title: Fix memory leak: URL.createObjectURL never revoked in AudioUpload
acceptanceCriteria: URL.createObjectURL in AudioUpload audio preview (line ~289) is created once and revoked on unmount or file change
The object URL created in handleFileSelect (line ~87) for duration detection is revoked after metadata loads
No blob: URLs accumulate in browser memory during repeated file selections
Existing drag-and-drop and file picker functionality unchanged
userStories.notes: AudioUpload.tsx creates object URLs inline in JSX on every render and in handleFileSelect without revoking them. Each unreleased URL holds a reference to the file blob in memory.

userStories.title: Fix React anti-pattern: state updates during render in TranscriptionResults
acceptanceCriteria: setSpeakerNames call (line ~85-87) moved into a useEffect hook
setEditableText initialization (line ~97-99) moved into a useEffect hook
No React strict mode warnings about state updates during render
Speaker names and editable text still sync correctly when transcription/analysis changes
userStories.notes: TranscriptionResults.tsx sets state directly inside the render body (outside useEffect/useCallback), causing extra re-renders and React strict mode warnings.

userStories.title: Fix formatSpeakerName only replacing first underscore
acceptanceCriteria: formatSpeakerName in transcriptUtils.ts uses regex /_/g to replace ALL underscores
MyRecordings.tsx fallback speaker formatting also replaces all underscores
Speaker IDs like 'Speaker_1_extra' render as 'Speaker 1 extra', not 'Speaker 1_extra'
Existing speaker name display unchanged for single-underscore IDs
userStories.notes: String.replace('_', ' ') only replaces the first occurrence. Need replaceAll or regex with global flag.

userStories.title: Fix AbortController signals not wired to fetch in useAnalysis and useTranscription
acceptanceCriteria: AbortController signal from useAnalysis is passed through to the underlying fetch call
AbortController signal from useTranscription is passed through to the underlying fetch call
Calling cancel/cancelTranscription actually aborts the in-flight HTTP request
AbortError is caught and handled gracefully (no error toast on intentional cancel)
userStories.notes: Both hooks create AbortControllers and check signal.aborted after calls, but the signal is never passed to the fetch request in api.ts. Cancellation only prevents state updates, not the actual network request.

userStories.title: Fix double cache miss recording in diarize endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: When cache lookup finds metadata without diarization, exactly one cache miss is recorded
When cache lookup finds metadata with diarization but blob load fails, exactly one cache miss is recorded (not two)
Cache hit rate metrics are accurate
All existing cache tests pass
userStories.notes: In transcribe.py diarize endpoint: when cached_meta exists but has_diarization is false, or when blob load fails inside the diarized cache path, cache_metrics.record_miss() can be called twice.

userStories.title: Fix MyRecordings status badge using has_diarization instead of has_analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Status badge shows 'Analyzed' only when has_analysis is true
Status badge shows 'Complete' for transcriptions without analysis regardless of diarization
Filtering by status works correctly with the updated logic
Existing MyRecordings tests updated accordingly
userStories.notes: MyRecordings.tsx transformRecord sets status to 'analyzed' based on has_diarization instead of has_analysis. A diarized recording without AI analysis incorrectly shows as 'Analyzed'.

userStories.title: Sanitize internal error details from HTTP responses
acceptanceCriteria: All HTTPException details in transcriptions.py, transcribe.py, and analyze.py use generic user-facing messages
Internal error details (Azure SDK messages, stack traces) are logged server-side only
A consistent error response format is used across all endpoints
Health and ready endpoints still return useful diagnostic info (non-sensitive)
userStories.notes: Multiple endpoints include raw exception message in HTTP error detail field (e.g., detail=f'Failed to list transcriptions: {e}'). In production, internal error details should not be exposed to clients.

userStories.title: Add rate limiting to API endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Transcription endpoints (POST /transcribe, /transcribe/diarize, /transcribe/batch) have per-user rate limits
Analysis endpoint (POST /analyze) has per-user rate limits
Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining) included in responses
429 Too Many Requests returned when limits exceeded
Health/ready endpoints are not rate limited
userStories.notes: The API has no rate limiting. Authenticated users could abuse batch transcription, analysis, or upload endpoints. README mentions rate limits but none are implemented.

userStories.title: Replace window.confirm with proper modal for destructive actions
acceptanceCriteria: Delete recording uses a styled confirmation modal instead of window.confirm()
Modal clearly states what will be deleted
Modal has Cancel and Delete buttons with appropriate styling
Accessibility: modal traps focus and supports keyboard navigation
userStories.notes: MyRecordings.tsx uses window.confirm() for destructive delete operations, which is a poor UX for production.

userStories.title: Remove duplicate datetime imports in transcriptions.py
acceptanceCriteria: datetime and UTC imported once at module level in transcriptions.py
All inline `from datetime import UTC, datetime` removed from function bodies
No behavioral changes to any endpoint
userStories.notes: transcriptions.py imports `from datetime import UTC, datetime` inside two separate function bodies instead of at module level.

userStories.title: Extract shared utility functions from duplicate frontend code
acceptanceCriteria: downloadFile utility extracted to a shared utils module
formatFileSize utility extracted to a shared utils module
formatDuration utility extracted to a shared utils module
formatTimeMsChat removed in favor of existing formatTimeMs from transcriptUtils
TranscriptionResults.tsx and MyRecordings.tsx import from shared utils
AudioUpload.tsx imports shared formatFileSize and formatDuration
All existing functionality unchanged
userStories.notes: downloadFile, formatFileSize, formatDuration, and formatTimeMsChat are duplicated across TranscriptionResults.tsx, MyRecordings.tsx, and AudioUpload.tsx.

userStories.title: Remove legacy get_current_user auth dependency
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy get_current_user function removed from dependencies.py
Legacy get_optional_user function removed if also unused
get_token_validator dependency removed if only used by legacy path
All routers confirmed to use get_current_user_azure exclusively
All existing auth tests pass
userStories.notes: dependencies.py contains both the legacy PyJWT-based get_current_user and the modern get_current_user_azure. The legacy one is not used by any router.

userStories.title: Fix or remove non-functional UserPreferences PATCH endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /auth/me/preferences either persists preferences or is removed entirely
If removed: OpenAPI spec no longer shows the endpoint
If kept: endpoint clearly documented as not persisted (or actually persists)
No misleading API behavior for consumers
userStories.notes: PATCH /auth/me/preferences accepts preferences but explicitly does not persist them - it echoes them back. This is misleading for API consumers.

userStories.title: Guard against NaN in maxSpeakers input
acceptanceCriteria: Clearing the max speakers input field does not set state to NaN
Non-numeric input in the field falls back to DEFAULT_MAX_SPEAKERS or previous value
Valid numeric input between MIN_SPEAKERS and MAX_SPEAKERS still works normally
userStories.notes: AudioUpload.tsx Number(e.target.value) can produce NaN for non-numeric input (e.g., clearing the field), which would set maxSpeakers to NaN and potentially cause API errors.

userStories.title: Fix audio_format hardcoded as 'wav' for batch transcription metadata
acceptanceCriteria: Batch transcription metadata stores the actual audio format (mp3, m4a, mp4, etc.)
audio_format is passed through from file validation to batch result handler
My Recordings displays correct format for batch-transcribed files
userStories.notes: transcribe.py batch transcription result handler hardcodes audio_format='wav' even though the original file could be MP3, M4A, etc.

userStories.title: Fix MAX_FILE_SIZE documentation mismatch (docs say 500MB, code allows 1GB)
acceptanceCriteria: API_DESCRIPTION in main.py states the correct file size limit matching the code
Backend MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES and frontend MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB are consistent
OpenAPI schema reflects actual limit
userStories.notes: Backend code allows 1GB, frontend allows 1024MB, but API description says '500 MB'. Documentation and code must agree.

userStories.title: Add React ErrorBoundary to prevent blank screen on unhandled errors
acceptanceCriteria: An ErrorBoundary component wraps the App component in main.tsx
Unhandled errors display a user-friendly fallback UI instead of blank screen
Fallback UI offers a 'Reload' button
Errors are logged (console or external service)
Auth errors are handled gracefully without crashing the entire app
userStories.notes: main.tsx has no ErrorBoundary. Any unhandled error in any component will crash the entire app with a blank screen.

userStories.title: Fix inconsistent created_at parsing in get_transcription endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: get_transcription endpoint parses upload_time string to datetime consistently
Same parsing logic used as list_transcriptions and get_transcription_by_hash
No serialization errors when returning TranscriptionRecord with string-based created_at
userStories.notes: transcriptions.py get_transcription endpoint passes created_at=meta.get('upload_time') as a raw string from JSON, while other endpoints carefully parse it to datetime.

userStories.title: Fix language field not propagated from server response in diarized transcription
acceptanceCriteria: useTranscription hook uses response.language (server-detected) for diarized results, not the input language parameter
TranscriptionResult.language reflects actual detected language
Non-diarized path unchanged (already correct)
userStories.notes: useTranscription.ts sets language to the input parameter instead of response.language for diarized transcriptions, losing the server-detected language.

userStories.title: Fix SPEAKER_COLORS shared state leaking across transcription views
acceptanceCriteria: Speaker color assignments are scoped per transcription view, not shared globally
Viewing transcription A then transcription B gives each its own consistent color scheme
Colors are still consistent within a single transcription view across re-renders
userStories.notes: transcriptUtils.ts SPEAKER_COLORS is a module-level mutable object. Colors from one transcription persist and affect another transcription's color assignments.

userStories.title: Prevent static path traversal and API fallback masking
acceptanceCriteria: SPA catch-all route rejects path traversal attempts and does not serve files outside static directory
Unknown API paths return proper API 404/JSON behavior instead of index.html fallback
Frontend client-side routes still resolve to index.html as expected
No regression in static asset delivery under /assets
userStories.notes: main.py catch-all route serves arbitrary full_path candidates and falls back to index.html, which can mask missing API routes and introduces filesystem path handling risk.

userStories.title: Return HTTP 503 for failed readiness checks
acceptanceCriteria: GET /ready returns HTTP 200 only when all dependencies are healthy
GET /ready returns HTTP 503 when one or more dependencies are unhealthy
Response body status remains descriptive (ready/not_ready)
Health endpoint behavior (/health) remains unchanged
userStories.notes: health.py documents 503 for readiness failures but currently always returns 200 with status='not_ready', which can break orchestrator gating.

userStories.title: Remove auth claim and identifier leakage from logs/errors
acceptanceCriteria: Auth dependency logs do not emit full claim sets, OID, tenant ID, or email at info level
401 responses do not include claim names or token-structure hints
Only minimal non-sensitive context is logged for auth failures
Debug-level diagnostics remain optional and sanitized
userStories.notes: auth/dependencies.py currently logs claim keys and user identifiers and returns claim key names in 401 detail, increasing information disclosure risk.

userStories.title: Harden CORS defaults for production safety
acceptanceCriteria: Production startup requires explicit CORS origins configuration instead of permissive localhost defaults
Credentialed CORS is only enabled for trusted origins
Development workflow remains convenient via env-configured local origins
Misconfiguration is surfaced clearly at startup
userStories.notes: main.py defaults to localhost origins with allow_credentials=True. If environment variables are omitted in production, origin policy may be weaker than intended.

userStories.title: Fix frontend vite/client type-resolution reliability
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript build and editor diagnostics resolve vite/client types reliably on clean environments
No compile error for missing type definition file 'vite/client'
tsconfig include/types settings align with installed dependencies
CI typecheck passes without manual local cache intervention
userStories.notes: Current diagnostics report missing vite/client type definitions from tsconfig.app.json, indicating environment-sensitive type resolution fragility.

userStories.title: Remove unused azure auth dependency factory helper
acceptanceCriteria: Unused _create_azure_user_dependency helper is removed
Any unused imports introduced by its removal are cleaned up
Authentication behavior remains unchanged
Auth tests continue to pass
userStories.notes: auth/dependencies.py defines _create_azure_user_dependency but it is not referenced elsewhere.
